summary: Stop scanner camera streams across unmount and re-entry races
description:
Follow-up from PR #10 review. If getUserMedia resolves after scanner unmount, the stream can be assigned after cleanup and remain live. Re-entering camera startup before the first await completes can also orphan a stream.

Conditions of Success:
- A stream resolving after unmount is stopped immediately and never attached
- Repeated camera-start actions cannot create or orphan multiple streams
- Normal camera startup, detector failure fallback, and paste mode continue to work
- Tests deterministically cover delayed getUserMedia resolution, unmount, and re-entry
- make check passes

objective.note: Guarantee camera hardware is released across asynchronous lifecycle races.

scope.note: Scanner startCamera lifecycle only: delayed permission resolution, unmount, and repeated start.

uncertainties.note: Use a mounted/generation guard and an in-flight start guard; no UX decision required.

dependencies.note: Extends the scanner fallback tests completed in TKT-46.

approach.note: Add deterministic deferred getUserMedia tests first, then guard stream assignment and startup re-entry.

first_slice.note: Unmount while getUserMedia is pending and assert the eventually resolved track is stopped.

success.note: No stream can survive unmount or be orphaned by repeated startup.
